partial: Short round — this club's archive is still growing.
locked: This gate is not ready yet.
unavailable: The round changed or the gate was closed. Reload to start a fresh round.
order: Select each item in order. Tap a selected item to remove it.
match: Choose one value for each row.
empty: No round meets these filters. Choose another topic or era.
memorySub: Every pair connects two faces of a sourced club fact.
slot: Choose a position on the pitch
saved: Your XI is saved on this device for this club.
savedUnavailable: Local storage is unavailable. Your XI remains available during this visit.
xiSub: A free choice of eleven players. Documented positions guide your picks; unknown details stay unknown.
duplicate: This player is already in your eleven.
archiveSub: The club's history, entry by entry. Search a name or a place, or see what happened on this day.
nothingToday: No eligible record for this date. Explore all history.
legacy: Carried forward from the curated legacy archive; no new source approval is claimed.
localOnly: Kept on this device only. No account, no leaderboard.
noActivity: Play a round or save an XI to start your activity record.
noPlayers: Player research and approval are needed before this gate can open.
pollSub: Choose from documented club moments and players. Your choices are saved on this device.
pollReplay: Which documented match would you watch again?
pollStory: Which event would you feature in your club story?
pollCalendar: Which club date would you mark on your calendar?
pollCaptain: Who would captain your personal XI?
pollMeet: Which documented player would you like to meet?
pollFirstXI: Who would you choose first for your personal XI?
pollSaved: Your choices are saved on this device.
mysterySub: Identify a club player from sourced clues. More clues and wrong guesses add time.
mysteryScoring: Each extra clue adds 15 seconds; each distinct wrong guess adds 5 seconds.
lineupSub: Pick the eleven who started. Eleven correct to complete the sheet.
kitSub: A hidden season's shirt on the glass: place its colours, design, maker and sponsor, then see the real one.
kitsSub: The club's documented shirts as a collection, and a studio for your own fan design.
kitNoPaint: Colour not painted: printed as a label only.
derbySub: The rivalry wall: the approved rival and every meeting the two archives record.
derbyNone: No meetings recorded in the archives.
goalLocked: Goal reconstruction needs sourced positions and cleared footage. It opens when a club archive holds them.
rumbleLocked: Royal Rumble needs documented player attributes. It opens when a club archive holds them.
rumbleSub: Draft five: keeper, defender, two midfielders, forward. Three cards each. Budget 15.
rumbleNote: Ratings are rank inside position from the club's own approved archive. Missing data counts as neutral, never as weak.
goalSub: Rebuild the goal touch by touch: who had the ball, what he did, and where the report puts it.
goalPickFirst: Pick who and what, then tap a zone.
goalApprox: Zones are a reading of the reporter's words, not coordinates.
blurb.xi: Pick your eleven from every player who wore the shirt.
blurb.trivia: Quick-fire questions from the club's own record.
blurb.lineup: Name the eleven who started a famous match.
blurb.kit-builder: Build the shirt: season, maker and design.
blurb.kits: The shirts the club has worn, season by season.
blurb.memory: Turn the cards and match the pairs.
blurb.polls: Your vote on the terrace's big questions.
blurb.goal: Rebuild a famous goal, touch by touch.
blurb.royal-rumble: Draft five players on a budget and kick off.
blurb.blind-cow: Guess the player from the clues.
blurb.derby: Every meeting with the old rival.
blurb.archive: Search the club's history, or see what happened on this day.
blurb.timeline: Put the club's moments in order.
lockedNote: We only open a game when there is enough sourced history to play it properly. Try another gate in the meantime.
rr.introBody: Three cards a slot, €15M to spend. The other five was fixed before your first pick.
rr.editHint: Tap a slot to change it
rr.rule1: Every card costs €1M to €5M. Your five must fit €15M.
rr.rule2: Pick keeper, defender, two midfielders and a forward. Tap a slot in your five to go back.
rr.rule3: A faded card would leave you unable to fill the five, so it cannot be picked.
rr.rule4: One shuffle, and only before the first pick.
rr.rule5: The opponent is the strongest five another deal makes from the players you did not take.
rr.ratingNever: Ratings stay on the server: a rank inside each position from the club's own approved archive, career span and recorded goals. Missing data counts as neutral, never as weak.
rr.kitNote: Shirts: the club's documented kit nearest each player's years, home for yours and away for theirs. Where no kit is documented, the club colours.
rr.question: Who takes the {position} spot?
rr.invalid: That five could not be checked. Deal a new board and try again.
rr.goal.1: {name} gets there first and buries it.
rr.save.0: {name} shoots, {keeper} turns it round the post.
rr.save.2: A big chance for {name}. {keeper} gets a glove to it.
rr.chance.0: {name} breaks through and the crowd rises.
rr.chance.1: {name} threads it, nobody gets on the end.
rr.chance.2: Half a yard for {name}, and it is gone.
rr.wonBody: Your money went to the right players.
rr.lostBody: Their deal had the edge today. Run it back.
rr.summaryNone: Two keepers, no goals: a game of nerves.
rr.secret: The ratings never left the server. What you saw is what they played.
rr.recentEmpty: Your last rounds on this device show up here.
beenHint: Mark it: it goes into Me → My story
triviaSub: Answer sourced questions about the club's history. Choose a topic or an era, or take a mixed round.
rr.vsPick: Pick the opponent's club — yours or any other.
rr.duelBanner: {club} sent you their five. Pick the club you play for — any club, theirs too — draft, and beat them.
rr.challenge: Challenge a friend with this five
rr.challengeCopied: Link copied. They pick any club and play your five.
rr.challengeHint: Your five goes in the link — no ratings, only the men.
rr.challengeFail: Could not copy — long-press the link instead.
